B. Mets. 104ᵃ; B. Bath. 7ᵃ if one says (כרם) כרמא אני מוכר לך וכ׳ ‘I sell thee a vineyard’, although there are no vines in it &c.; והוא דמתקרי כ׳ provided the property goes by the name of vineyard (Karma); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 42b:7">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ממתניתן דכ׳ וכ׳</he> he changed his opinion on account of what had been taught in the college (at Jamnia), v. preced.—[<cite ref="Yevamot 121a">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>בכרמא</he>, v. <cite ref="K01232"><he>כַּרְמִי</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="K01232"><he>כַּרְמִין</he></cite>, <he>כַּרְמַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="K01232"><he>כַּרְמֵי</he></cite>.
